preconditions.description: n is a positive integer within the specified range.
2k is a non-negative integer such that 2k is less than or equal to n.

postconditions.description: The output permutation a has a length of 2n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 2 * n for x in a)
postconditions.description: All elements in the permutation a are distinct positive integers between 1 and 2n.
All elements in the permutation a are unique.

postconditions.expression: sum(abs(a[2 * i - 1] - a[2 * i]) for i in range(n)) - abs(sum(a[2 * i - 1] - a[2 * i] for i in range(n))) == 2 * k
postconditions.description: The permutation a satisfies the given equation involving absolute differences.
